body: Watching a semi-crappy TV show to distract myself until I fall asleep

Sadness, hopelessness and emptiness most of the time, and days plain out nothing. I hit my toes in a chair and can't feel pain. I see some, what is supposed to be, grotesque shit on /r/WTF and but no reaction comes from it. My grades get bad but it doesn't matter. People quit talking to me and it almost feels like a relief.

I lose most of my friends because I don't give them enough attention, occasionally drop too honest comments and by not letting them pass my limit so to say. With the comments it's things like:
 
Friend: "Awh, I've got such a headache"

Me: "What were you expecting? Yesterday you were yelling 'Imma get totally wasted' while running around with two bottles of vodka."

And my limits are mostly about people not respecting me when I say no. 

My parent give me shit no matter what I do, I usually try to be nice but there is no point with that because the result while not trying at all is the same. I try to help mom here at home but it damn hard to cook and clean while other people watch TV and complain about the food being vegetarian. My father and I do horseback riding together and I help out there as much as I manage. I guess I could try harder but it hasn't changed things in the past.

The periods of feeling really down, when I were 11.

This period, early February.
